subject: Recap + asks: cost scenarios, batching levers & pilot ROI (Lumeno)
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@lumeno.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + asks: cost scenarios, batching levers & pilot ROI (Lumeno)

Hi Priya — thanks again for the call today. Quick written recap so we’re aligned and can move to a scoped pilot that fits Lumeno’s budget window. I’ve attached a short technical questionnaire and a draft MAP.

Key pain you described
- Real-time chat suggestions are burning tokens quickly (spikes during peak hours) and are unpredictable for forecasting.
- Current infra spend on inference is pushing the cost per monthly active user beyond product targets.
- Procurement needs a 1–2 month window and a clearly scoped pilot with measurable ROI to sign off.

Goals you asked us to help with
1) A pilot that demonstrates a 30–40% effective per-response cost reduction (token-equivalent) while keeping NPS delta < 3 pts.
2) A 3-week technical pilot proving batching/caching levers at real traffic patterns.
3) A deterministic forecast and a one-page ROI model for procurement.

High-level cost levers we discussed (what Redwood will test):
- Continuous/elastic batching tuned to your median latency SLO (we’ll model tradeoffs at 50ms/100ms P90).
- Prefix/KV caching for frequent intents (we’ll measure hit-rate uplift hypotheses, target 20–35% cache hit).
- Model quantization profile: evaluate a 4/8-bit variant for non-critical NLU paths.

Immediate asks (what we need from Lumeno by EOD Wed):
- 2 weeks of representative traffic logs (anonymized) or a sample event stream (we’ll provide the ingestion spec).
- Top 5 intents you'd like to prioritize for cache tests.
- Budget band (ballpark) for pilot so we can size reserved capacity vs on-demand runs.

Proposed pilot outline / timeline (subject to your inputs)
- Week 0: Ingest sample traffic + finalize MAP (mutual_action_plan.xlsx attached).
- Week 1: Config baseline + run initial parallel A/B (current infra vs Redwood small pool).
- Week 2: Apply batching/caching heuristics and quantized model variant; measure token burn and latency.
- Week 3: ROI readout + procurement-ready one-pager.

Attachments: lumeno_technical_qs.pdf, redwood_mutual_action_plan.xlsx

Next steps
- Priya: send traffic sample + top intents by Wednesday.
- Ben / Marissa / me: prepare a short ROI workbook and initial price band for reserved capacity.

If that all looks right I’ll convert the MAP to a simple SOW and include a pricing appendix with the three cost scenarios (on-demand, mixed reserved, reserved+quantized).

Thanks —
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Redwood Inference — predictable, production LLM inference
From: Priya Sharma <priya@lumeno.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + asks: cost scenarios, batching levers & pilot ROI (Lumeno)

Dylan — thank you for the clear write-up. Confirming we’re aligned on scope and a few clarifications from procurement:

1) Budget constraint: we have a pilot cap of ~$45k for vendor evaluation this quarter (covers infra and SE time).
2) Timeline: procurement needs the ROI one-pager + SOC2 evidence before we can start any contract — can you include a pointer to your SOC2 report?
3) Traffic sample: we can provide 10k anonymized events covering peak windows by Wednesday EOD.

Quick questions
- For the ROI one-pager, can the model show both token-level cost and a blended per-MAU number? Procurement likes simple $/MAU estimates.
- On latency: our P90 target for user-visible suggestions is <120ms; anything above that will degrade the UX. Please show the latency tradeoff table alongside cost scenarios.

Attached: our internal product brief (small) and a procurement contact in case we need to speed approvals (procurement@lumeno.com).

We’re excited to see the caching numbers — I’ll send the sample logs later today.

Best,
Priya
Head of Product, Lumeno Labs
priya@lumeno.com | (415) 555-3310
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Recap + asks: cost scenarios, batching levers & pilot ROI (Lumeno) — internal checklist

Forwarding Priya’s ack — quick internal checklist before I draft the pricing band and ROI one-pager:
- Create 3 pricing scenarios: (A) short on-demand run, (B) mixed reserved (50% commit), (C) 3-month reserved + quantization uplift. Include per-MAU and per-response columns.
- ROI model: assume 100k MAU baseline, 2M monthly suggestions, show cost delta at 20/30/40% effective token savings.
- Latency table: show P50/P90 for each scenario with expected batching delay at target SLOs (50ms/100ms/120ms).
- Prep SOC2 pointer and a short note on data retention/default retention for pilot.
- Draft MAP to include acceptance criteria and success metrics (target cache hit >20% and <3pt NPS change).

Marissa — can you take lead on the ROI workbook? Dylan — I’ll start the pricing appendix and SOC2 pointer. I’ll also populate HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890

Ben
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
